My position system has no breakout-volume threshold: the buy signal is the break above resistance (C26) confirmed by the COM/TIF proxies (C28). Grid: W 0.5% under the 20-wk high, D close 658.1 over ema9 629.0345, HH/HL, green bar. The volume bar is O'Neil's test, not mine; my test stands.

'Not Crabel's contraction breakout; expansion, no contraction.' My position system asks for no contraction: buying the break of resistance is the entry and strength is the signal (C26). D close 33.07 over ema9 30.0858 with HH/HL is the trend I buy, not a fault there. H1 LH/LL is not a frame my exits read (C14: red bar or close below support).

'50-day under the 200-day and RS rank under 70.' No 50 or 200 average is in my method (C1). Rank: R12 does ask a high rs_rank_pct and I already named mine as middling, a caution; R8, my odds gate, passes. Grid: W HH/HL 0.7% under the 20-wk high, D close 66.84 over ema9 63.2007, green. Signal stands; rank caution kept.

'Deep liquidity is NOT_AVAILABLE; flow shows no accumulation.' Fair on my own fields: avg_vol_20d was on my cannot_see list, so 'deep liquidity' was unproven (C25), and cmf, my COM proxy, was not served. I concede both words. The break stands on my test: D close 95.83 over ema9 93.2827, HH/HL, 0.4% under the 20-day high, TIF ACCELERATION.

'A range-expansion leg, not a contraction break.' Contraction is not my test; extension above the averages is not a fault in the position system (C26, R10). D close 99.63 over ema9 88.9206 is the break running. I note W and D hh_hl_3 mixed as a caution; my exit is a close below support or a red bar (C14), not the leg's width.

'day_vol 1.22 under 1.40; W 5.6% under 20-wk high.' My claim was above resistance, not a new high, and my system has no 1.40 volume floor. D close 29.89 over ema9 26.6774 with HH/HL, 2.6% under the 20-day high, is a live resistance break (C26). The weekly gap to its high is a caution, not a fail on my test.
